input.change_text: *(auth)* [**breaking**] support returning extra fields from token exchange ([#700](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk/pull/700))

output.subject: mcp-rust-sdk token-exchange return type now carries extra fields
output.action_text: Update auth-flow call sites in `mcp-rust-sdk` rmcp-v1.0.0-alpha+ to handle the widened token-exchange return type. PR #700 lets servers surface extra fields alongside the access token; existing destructuring patterns will fail to compile until you accept the new shape.
